prompt: Was the person who served as president of the Scottish National Party from 1987 to 2005 alive when the party was founded?
answer: Yes. The person was **Winnie Ewing**, born on **10 July 1929**. The Scottish National Party was founded in **1934**, so she was alive—about five years old—when the party was established.
